SELECT REC_EMPLOYEE.REC_EMPLOYEE_NO, REC_INTERVIEW.REC_INTERVIEW_NO, REC_EMPLOYEE.EMP_NAME, get_global_name(REC_EMPLOYEE.CERT_TYPE_CODE, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) CERT_TYPE, CERT_NUMBER, EMP_TELPHONE, EMP_ADDRESS, get_global_name(REC_EMPLOYEE.SEX_CODE, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) SEX, get_global_name(REC_EMPLOYEE.NATIONALITY_CODE, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) NATIONALITY, EMP_BIRTHDAY, FINAL_SCHOOL, get_global_name(REC_EMPLOYEE.FINAL_EDU_CODE, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) FINAL_EDU, FINAL_GRAD_DATE, EMP_EMAIL, get_global_name(REC_EMPLOYEE.POST_TYPE_CODE, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) POST_TYPE, REC_INTERVIEW.FINAL_CONFIRM FINAL_CONFIRM, WORK_EXPERIENCE, REC_EMPLOYEE.OLD_COMPANY, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(REC_EMPLOYEE.INTERVIEW_PERIOD, 'YYYY/MM/DD'), 'DD/MM/YYYY') INTERVIEW_PERIOD, TRUNC((sysdate - TO_DATE(EMP_BIRTHDAY,'YYYY.MM.DD'))/365,0) AGE, FILE_PATH, REC_TYPE, REC_EMPLOYEE.CREATE_DATE CREATE_DATE, REC_EMPLOYEE.CREATED_BY CREATED_BY, REC_EMPLOYEE.UPDATE_DATE UPDATE_DATE, REC_EMPLOYEE.UPDATED_BY UPDATED_BY, REC_EMPLOYEE.ACTIVITY ACTIVITY, FILE_NAME FROM REC_EMPLOYEE, REC_INTERVIEW WHERE REC_EMPLOYEE.REC_EMPLOYEE_NO = REC_INTERVIEW.REC_EMPLOYEE_NO(+) AND REC_EMPLOYEE.ACTIVITY = 1
EMP_NAME LIKE upper('%'||#KEY#||'%')
REC_EMPLOYEE.POST_TYPE_CODE = #POST:VARCHAR#
FINAL_EDU_CODE = #EDUCATION:VARCHAR#
REC_TYPE = #TYPE:NUMBER#
WORK_EXPERIENCE >= #CONCOUNT:VARCHAR#
WORK_EXPERIENCE = #CONCOUNT:VARCHAR#
REC_INTERVIEW.FINAL_CONFIRM = #INTERVIEW:VARCHAR#
REC_EMPLOYEE.OLD_COMPANY = #OLD_COMPANY:VARCHAR#
REC_EMPLOYEE.EMP_TELPHONE = #EMP_TELPHONE:VARCHAR#
TO_DATE(REC_EMPLOYEE.INTERVIEW_PERIOD, 'YYYY/MM/DD') >= TO_DATE(#INTERVIEW_PERIOD:VARCHAR#, 'YYYY/MM/DD')
ORDER BY REC_INTERVIEW.REC_INTERVIEW_NO DESC

SELECT RE.REC_AFFIRM_NO, RE.REC_INTERVIEW_NO, HRE.LOCAL_NAME, RE.AFFIRM_LEVEL, RE.AFFIRMOR_ID, RE.AFFIRM_FLAG, RE.AFFIRM_REMARK, RE.CREATE_DATE, RE.CREATED_BY, RE.UPDATE_DATE, RE.UPDATED_BY, GET_DEPT_NAME(HRE.DEPTNO,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#) DEPARTMENT_NAME, get_global_name(HRE.POST_NO,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#) POST_GRADE,
RE.ACTIVITY FROM REC_AFFIRM RE, REC_INTERVIEW REI, REC_EMPLOYEE REE,HR_EMPLOYEE HRE WHERE RE.REC_INTERVIEW_NO = REI.REC_INTERVIEW_NO AND REE.REC_EMPLOYEE_NO = REI.REC_EMPLOYEE_NO AND RE.AFFIRMOR_ID = HRE.EMPID AND REE.REC_EMPLOYEE_NO = #REC_EMPLOYEE_NO#
